_comment: Declared inputs for the conformance gate. Maintained WITH the docs (Part 3 anti-staleness). owner_match is a distinctive substring of the concept's owning-page URL; a link whose target contains it counts as bridging that concept (S4).
_levers_comment: ADJUSTABLE LEVERS. The verdict schema is configuration, not code: retune which rule maps to which severity, rename the tiers, or add contradiction_patterns without touching conformance_gate.py. Non-compensating: a page's verdict is its WORST finding's tier, so clean prose never offsets a Block.

contradiction_patterns.reason: Asserts plugin availability in Chat as settled fact, but the matrix records Chat availability as a LIVE contradiction between the support guidance and cowork/guide/plugins.
contradiction_patterns.note: Do not state Chat availability as settled until the product owner resolves the conflict. Describe it as unresolved and link the support matrix.

contradiction_patterns.note: Reconcile with the availability owner: either the 'coming soon' copy is stale or this claim is premature. Do not publish both.
